name: Select
summary: Choose a single value from a closed list, in the Aurea skin.

a11y.keyboardNote: Since 24/09/2026 the Select is the Base UI select wearing the Aurea skin, not the native <select>: the list the native element opens belongs to the operating system and no author CSS reaches it. The trigger is a <button> with role combobox; the list opens below it with the same panel, 18px row radius and check column as the Combobox list. Printable-character typeahead still works and is not listed as a key because it is any character.

props.name: children
props.description: <option> and <optgroup> elements, read the way the browser reads them: an option without value uses its text. Kept so code written for the native <select> keeps working; the list itself is drawn by the Aurea.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The chosen value, as a string. Without value, defaultValue or placeholder the first enabled option is chosen, which is what the native <select> did.

props.name: items
props.description: The list as data: { value, label, disabled? } or groups { label, items }. Use it instead of <option> children when the list comes from data.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with an event-shaped object, so handlers written for the native <select> (reading e.target.value) keep working.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the chosen value directly.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown in the trigger while nothing is chosen. Giving one also stops the first option from being chosen by default.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name. The value is submitted through a hidden input, as the native element did.

props.name: required
props.description: The form will not submit without a value.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Choosing a VALUE is Select; executing an ACTION is a Menu.

props.name: size
props.description: The system's size step, NOT the HTML size attribute — that one is how many options show at once, and it is deliberately shadowed here.
